text: Local implementation and proof are complete, but publication cannot proceed without explicit repository authority: mesh4s and spatial4s have no configured remotes, visibility has not been chosen, and locus4s 4aa95b5 is an unpushed commit on agent/scala-guide. Required external sequence is approve visibility/ownership, push or merge the reviewed locus bridge, create/push spatial4s, pin mesh4s to the pushed hashes, create/push mesh4s, then run a fresh remote-only checkout matrix. Do not infer permission for those writes.
